movelist.name: Take Down
movelist.effect: You may perform a Trip Maneuver against the target as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Fire Fang
movelist.effect: Fire Fang Burns or Flinches on 18-19 during Accuracy Check; flip a coin to determine whether the foe gets Burned or Flinches. On 20 during Accuracy Check, the foe is Burned and Flinches.

movelist.name: Reversal
movelist.effect: For each Injury the user has, Reversal’s Damage Base is increased by +1.

movelist.name: Flame Wheel
movelist.effect: Flame Wheel Burns the target on 19+.

movelist.name: Helping Hand
movelist.effect: Helping Hand grants the target +2 on their next Accuracy Roll this round, and +10 to the next Damage Roll this round.

movelist.name: Odor Sleuth
movelist.effect: Odor Sleuth may be activated as a Swift Action on the user’s turn. For the rest of the turn, the user’s Normal-Type and Fighting-Type Moves can hit and affect Ghost-Type targets, and the user can see through the Illusion Ability, Moves with the Illusion keyword, and effects created by the Illusionist Capability, ignoring all effects from those.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.effect: Lower the target’s Attack 1 Combat Stage. You may target a specific foe only once per Scene with Intimidate.

abilities.name: Bodyguard
abilities.trigger: An adjacent Ally is hit by an attack
abilities.effect: The user and the triggering Ally switch places, and the user becomes the target of the triggering attack instead, taking damage from the attack as if resisted one step further. If switching places would not move the triggering Ally out of the area-of-effect of a Burst, Blast, Cone, or Line, this Ability does not prevent the ally from being hit. Defensive.
